effect.name: Squeeze (Switch)
effect.description: (This effect is an attempt to recreate Squeeze from the Alight Motion) Distorts texture by squeezing it along one axis while expanding it along the other axis.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Squeeze (Switch) Shader | 2026.09.02 */
parameter.description: (This effect is an attempt to recreate Squeeze from the Alight Motion) Distorts texture by squeezing it along one axis while expanding it along the other axis.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines what the base should be. Setting it to 1 sets the base as the texture of the object on which the effect is applied, and setting it to 0 sets this as the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable sets the intensity of base visibility.

parameter.name: Squeeze Size X
parameter.description: This variable determines the size of the squeeze effect on the X axis.

parameter.name: Squeeze Size Y
parameter.description: This variable determines the size of the squeeze effect on the Y axis.

parameter.name: Position X
parameter.description: A variable that determines the position of the texture in the X axis.

parameter.name: Position Y
parameter.description: A variable that determines the position of the texture in the Y axis.
